lines.en: I don't know. This is my real father.
And I just, I want things to be, like, just right.
Hey, you want to go home?
Uh, I'm guessing the threshold's clear now.
Oh, hey, how's the dog? Yeah.
Okay, I talked to the vet. People are so nice upstate.
Anyway, he said that the little fella's gonna be okay,
and I can pick him up tomorrow.
Yeah, but he did have to have, like, a bunch of stitches.
And he said that only once in a blue moon
does a dog's ear grow back, so...
